title: Async Callbacks
definition: The ability for asynchronous functions to be called directly in a callback context without explicit handling of asyncio tasks.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it as a smooth flow where tasks can be done simultaneously without waiting for others to finish before starting.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Asynchronous callbacks allow for non-blocking code execution, enabling efficient handling of IO-bound operations like network requests.
difficulty_levels.expert: Asynchronous callbacks are a cornerstone of event-driven programming, enabling the creation of scalable and responsive software. They are particularly useful in GUI programming to prevent the UI from freezing while waiting for I/O operations.

extra_fields.insight: NiceGUI 3.10.0 natively supports asynchronous callbacks, which simplifies the code and improves performance in certain scenarios.
